description: This file defines device configurations, build procedures, and functions for Ubiquiti devices within the OpenWRT firmware build system. It includes device-specific variables, build steps, and scripting for image creation tailored for various Ubiquiti hardware models.

classes.name: Device/ubnt
classes.description: Base device configuration for Ubiquiti devices, including common variables, image handling, and build definitions.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage
methods.description: Build step for creating Ubiquiti image with specific kernel and root filesystem.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage2
methods.description: Build step for creating a secondary type of Ubiquiti firmware image using mkfwimage2.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage-split
methods.description: Splits a firmware image into 1024K parts and rebuilds it for devices expecting larger kernel images.
